alt: 三代居民在園丁雕像前獻花，底座旁放著他種樹的舊照片，四周大樹已長成，家人在樹蔭下休息。
scene_prompt: A peaceful community garden built around the original bronze memorial sculpture of a kind, fictional older gardener holding a young sapling, atop a plain unlettered stone pedestal. A living elderly woman, a middle-aged father and a young child together place fresh flowers at its base; behind them thrive large shade trees and a flourishing garden, and other families enjoy their shelter. A weathered small framed wordless portrait at the pedestal shows this same gardener in earlier life planting the very same distinctive tree. Respectful remembrance across generations, not immortality or a living person posing. No inscriptions, dates, religious symbols or identifiable real person.
